source: McAuley Amazon Reviews 2023（公开研究数据集）
reviews: Once u get a handle of all of its features and functions - this Garmin bike computer will become a vital part of your cycling workouts. Syncing with Strava routes in a breeze. Creating workouts and syncing it to the device is super easy as well. I now use it to perform interval training which is making me a stronger and stronger rider after each workout.

This Garmin GPS navigator is much better than I thought it would be with its hands free navigation and phone integration for live weather and traffic information it’s so. Ugh nicer than using my iPhone for a navigation device. Garmin’s the best in my book!

These silicone holders for the Fitbit Inspire 2 fit fine. I've used them to fasten my Fitbit to the inside of my bra. I'm a little hesitant to put it where it could fall off such as my socks or sticking out of my pocket. It seems to be sturdy enough, I just am over protective of my tracker!

I love these bands. The original Fitbit bands are some sort of plastic and they trap moisture underneath, causing rashes and discomfort. Even the silicone bands can cause irritation. I tried leather and that was better than the silicone, but it doesn't breathe. These are really comfortable. I forget I'm wearing it and I can change them out and rinse them in the sink. It's made a huge difference in comfort.

I bought this to hold either my husbands phone or the Garmin. Neither one fit properly and I am not sure what fits in this thing. The phone lays too flat to see it when you are driving and the Garmin just will not fit.

The head unit works great. Touch screen is sensitive like a touch phone. Bluetooth is easy to setup and very adjustable for mike placement. GPS is Garmin good. Apple car play work good. Buy a good backup camera to go with it. This is a solid multi purpose unit at a good price, $120 less than anyone else at $479.95.

This replacement band for the Fitbit Versa 3 attaches easily to the Versa. I tugged on both ends of the strap once it was installed and they seem to be secure. The band is very easy to wear. It uses magnetism to keep the two ends in place. Adjusting the fit is a simple fix. I like to wear my Fitbit slightly loose as recommended in the instructions. So far, it seems to be working just fine!

This is a great assortment of colors! They fit the Fitbit Inspire 2 well and securely. It's fun being able to select different bands to match outfits and moods! I would say that they are comparable to the original band in quality, though they have a watch band type closure.

Beautiful band - it looks so nice - more like an amazing piece of jewelry really. I gave it only a 4 star because due to the way its made, the Fitbit Charger 2 plug is a bit difficult to get a good connection on the Fitbit - so I'm had issues getting a full charge and find it necessary to mess with the band and charger to get it just right.

I have been using this now for two weeks and it works great. Tracks my steps, calories burned, mileage walked, provides daily step goals, & shows time and date. Easy to sync up with Garmin connect to keep track of progress.
Very solid mount. Holds both my Garmin 1030+ and my Garmin Varia light safe and steady without vibration.

These mounts have the same size ball as Garmin mounts, and are somewhat of an improvement over the previous plastic mount. I use several Arkon sticky mounts with these and other attachments to hold my GPS, phone, XM radio, and a phone I use as a dash cam. They all work great.

Our family and friends are brand loyal for brands of excellence. This Garmin GPS is excellent, easy to set up and easy to use. Updates are simple. We bought this as a set with the dash stand (sand bag type) and it always stays in place The voice notifications are very clear and understandable Screen works great day and night

This is a pretty good tracker. I like that I can swim with it on. I am not too sure about how well it tracks steps or calories burned. I used to have a Fitbit and it seems like I burn less now than with the Garmin.
My old watch is broken so I got this new one. This is a great smart watch that could tracking my health situation when I go to the gym.
I had messed up my last fitbit and really wanted the same one.

So far so good. I almost always buy bands beyond what comes with the fitbit. I have the Sense, and these work just fine with it. Pop on. Cute little cut outs and scalloped edging add visual appeal. Has two loops for added security. Fits my 7" wrist.

My 80 year old Mom was interested in this band for her new fitbit 3... but it turned out to be too hard to put on and take off on her own. It's pretty enough.. and it adjusts for size easily by removing pieces without any special tools...but once we removed enough fitter pieces it was just too hard to use. We moved on to stretch bands (no closures) and some regular style watch like bands. If you are really dexterous, I'm sure you'd like this band it just didn't work for us.

The bands would not stay attached to my charge 3. If I swing my arm or my shirt sleeve bumped it the band would detach. I would not recommend this even though they look cool and it's nice to have a metal bracelet I need to work on the clip which connects it to the actual Fitbit device.
My son is very happy with his charger ...works great with the Garmin that he got for Christmas
Protects my Garmin S20 & charging cord excellent. Can leave it in my golf bag & never worry about losing it or getting damaged

This is quite the fashionable band for my Fitbit Versa! I love the floral print! I find it a little difficult to fasten. The silicone bands are definitely easier to clasp. I have a large wrist. I can wear this on the 2nd to the last hole, but it's a bit snug and does leave marks when I remove it. But if I put it on the last hole, it keeps coming undone throughout the day. I do like it, but I'm not wearing it every day, instead I am saving it for dressier occasions.

These straps fit my Versa 3 perfectly. They're easy to put on and take off. Once on, they stay in place well. I have not had any issues with any of them detaching while in use. I like having more options when it comes to my Fitbit bands. I really like the design that is engraved into them.

This is the prettiest Fitbit band ever! It looks professional and a lot dressier than the typical silicone bands. It was easy to put on and fits my wrist/tracker well. I have gotten compliments on it already!

This is a nice looking band. It is definitely an improvement from the original Fitbit one. It's a little stiff, but it seems to be softening or flexing more as it's worn. It was easy to attach to the unit and fits well.

I like having options when it comes to the band of my Fitbit Versa3. This one looks nice. It's a little less casual than the silicone ones. It fits my Versa fine and was easy to attach. I wear my Fitbit on my left arm (I'm right handed). I found it a little more difficult to put on my wrist than my other bands. I was able to get it, but it took a few tries. Once on my wrist, my Versa feels secure and I'm not concerned about it coming undone.

I ordered the wrong size! I have a Versa 3 not a 2 which these are made for. Luckily, I was able to give these to my sister who does own a Versa 2. These fit her Fitbit well. It's easy to change them. It feels secure and she doesn't worry about them coming off while in use. The assortment of colors/designs is fun and girly.

I got my daughter a Fitbit Flex for her birthday. I know a lot of people who have had issues with the Fitbit bands, so I wanted to get her one that was more like a regular watch band. She's had no issues with this band at all. It's secure when she wears it and is easy to take off and put back on. I would consider ordering more of these if she wants other colors.
Very universal. Holds my Garmin GPS and iPhone. Good quality product!
Replaced my wife’s Fitbit with it and she couldn’t be happier.
It fits my Fitbit charge 3 well. It looks like the original band. The colors look good. I’ve only had the bands for a month so I can’t speak to the durability but it seems sturdy enough.

This is second time my fitness tracker had stopped working. The warranty kicked in and gave me full refund the day after my claim. I just bought a third fitness tracker and purchased another warranty.
This is an awesome little organizer for personal use. It fits my 10ft charger, block, and Apple Watch charger with a little room to spare.
This is great! I put my Garmin in it. I have a Buick Enclave so there really aren't any flat surfaces on the dash but this sits nicely and doesn't move. I love it. Thank you.

These work well but it's terribly inconvenient to try and find a place to plug them in with a short cords. I realize that exact length of the actual Fitbit ones but I have told them to I am unhappy with the length of the cord

Switched to Apple Watch out of frustration with FitBit's deteriorating changes in design and software quality. The Apple Watch is so well designed and executed, even though the battery has to be recharged daily. It is still hard to believe that an advanced technology and design company like Apple cannot figure out how to make a wearable that can go several days between charges.
Love my new Fitbit Versa Lite! Charges fast and I like being able to read my text messages.

This was roughly 1/3 the price of the official Garmin replacement band, which lasted less than a year. This one is at least as equal in quality. We've had it about a month. If it lasts 3 more we're still ahead of the game.
I bought the silicone cover and the protective screen for my inreach mini. Both are super nice quality. The cover has to come off for the Garmin dive case. I’m very satisfied with both items.
